status: all three exact cross-system mappings remain blocked; no new interpretation adopted

fields.definition_summary: Term NT is current nominal value; for debt, remaining principal outstanding. The formal notation distinguishes the NT attribute from time-indexed Nt state.
fields.type: ACTUS term Real, positive in acquired term definition; applicable role-sensitive state convention must be established per contract.
fields.units: Nominal contract amount; fixture denomination currency EUR. The STK rules do not define an Nt state or its encoding; do not equate NT=1000 with purchase price1200, termination price3000, balance or zero state.
fields.time_basis: NT supplied with terms as of SD2012-12-30T00:00:00; no STK Nt(t0), Nt(PRD+), or Nt(TD+) initialization/update is specified by the inspected STK table.
fields.blocker: No STK-specific Nt state initialization or explicit common-result-schema applicability/default rule binds NT term1000 or undefined STK Nt to local UInt0. Equal field spelling does not bind term and state.

fields.definition_summary: Nominal rate used for accruals and next interest payment; NT times IPNR is a payment-calculation base, with time basis controlled by day count. Variable-rate contracts can update it at status date.
fields.type: ACTUS Real rate; generic arithmetic/domain may need signed rational/fixed-decimal representation, while Core1 UInt is unsigned u128.
fields.units: Per-annum rate (dimensionless annual fraction), not EUR amount; rate denominator/precision is not asset scale.
fields.time_basis: Rate applies over a year-fraction interval Y(s,t,DCC). The fixture has no IPNR, DCC, interest interval or STK Ipnr state rule.
fields.blocker: Absent IPNR is undefined per formal undef convention, not an automatic zero. STK state table does not initialize Ipnr. Need explicit applicability/export rule and an adopted rate-unit/precision adapter; PAM defaults do not transfer to STK.

fields.definition_summary: Accrued interest at SD; the term definition permits recalculation from payment-anchor/cycle/rate information when null. This is distinct from a local zero scalar.
fields.type: ACTUS Real accrued monetary amount; Core1 UInt is unsigned integral atomic units.
fields.units: Accrued monetary amount in the applicable contract denomination and sign convention; exact EUR atomic-unit scale/rounding is not selected by the STK state rules.
fields.time_basis: At SD for initial term, and pre/post-event times for states. Recalculation needs interest anchor/cycle/rate, applicable principal basis and Y(s,t,DCC); these are not supplied for STK04 and STK defines no Ipac recurrence.
fields.blocker: Neither absent term nor lack of interest events proves an exported Ipac=0. Need STK applicability/state definition or a separately adopted generic-result zero-padding convention, plus amount-scale/sign/time adapter. PAM Ipac=0 when IPNR undefined is confined to PAM initialization.

shared_precise_binding_gap: The supplied taxonomy is taxonomy only; it does not contain dictionary state definitions, applicability matrix, event-result wire schema, or an STK common-state default rule. Formal STK explicitly inherits only Prf and Sd from PAM.
unchanged_scope: No seven-field/full-fixture disposition, retained membership, counter or acceptance status changed.
